title: Python NumPy
description: NumPy is used for working with arrays. It also has functions for working in domain of linear algebra, fourier transform, and matrices.
example:
import numpy as np
arr = np.array([1, 2, 3])
print(arr)

challenges.title: Create Array
challenges.exercise: Import numpy as np and create an array [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]. Print the array.
challenges.solution:
import numpy as np
arr = np.array([1, 2, 3, 4, 5])
print(arr)
